about.title: A Technology Partner Built for the Long Term
about.lead: LinkYou is a Toronto-based software development and technology company helping organizations design, build, secure, and scale their digital products.
paragraphs: We work across the full technology stack — software engineering, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, mobile and web development, and digital marketing — to help clients turn ideas into dependable, scalable systems.

Our team has delivered work for municipal and federal government bodies, national telecom carriers, and private enterprises, which means every product we build is engineered to enterprise standards of security, reliability, and performance.
We believe a project isn't finished at launch. Our engineers stay engaged well beyond delivery, because software that matters needs a partner who stands behind it.
about.supportTitle: One Year of Free Support, Included
about.supportBody: Every project we deliver includes a full year of complimentary support. We monitor, maintain, and fine-tune your website or application after launch so it keeps running smoothly — at no additional cost.
about.statsSubtitle: A snapshot of the work behind every project we deliver.
